answer: Each identity keeps an atlas of one small neighborhood in the economy and serves as its raven, carrying messages only for those neighbors, who rate the service each epoch. A crystal of standing grows only from those ratings, bound to the identity key, so it cannot be bought, copied, or transferred. One operator cannot serve a thousand neighborhoods at once: each fake needs its own real neighborhood, its own hours of real service, and its own ratings, while one honest identity serves its single neighborhood well.
